# FDG5062

> DO pass `null` as the sender when raising a static event.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 5.4 Event Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: fdg (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: FDG5062
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Message: Pass null as the sender when raising the static event '{0}'

FDG5062 reports a call that raises a static field-like event directly (Event(...) or Event?.Invoke(...)) with a first argument that is not a constant null, when the event's delegate takes an object sender first. An event raised through a local copy of the delegate, as in the body's example, is not seen. The fix changes a call, not a signature; there is no code fix.

## From the book

```csharp
EventHandler<EventArgs> handler = ...;
if (handler!=null) handler(null,...);
```
